editorial:
Imagine you are heading back to a summer camp that has been closed for years because of a tragic accident. You are part of a group of young counselors who just want to hang out and get the place ready for kids, but someone is watching you from the woods. The vibe is classic 80s horror, with lots of tension and the feeling that you are never truly safe, even in your own cabins. You will find yourself rooting for the characters, even though you know the rules of these kinds of movies usually mean most of them won't make it to the end.

What really works here is the suspense and the way the killer picks off the group one by one. The acting is simple and fits the era, and while the pacing starts a bit slow, it ramps up into a wild ride. If you love old-school slashers, you need to see this. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, you find out the killer is actually Mrs. Voorhees, the camp owner's mother. She wanted revenge because her son Jason drowned years ago. The main character, Alice, fights her off in a scary struggle. Alice eventually kills Mrs. Voorhees with a machete to save herself. Just as she thinks she is safe and falls asleep, Jason suddenly jumps out of the water to scare her one last time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic horror and 80s movies.
